name: Json List
tagline: previewing JSON from file or url in a user-friendly list format
blurb: Json List is a lightweight tool for viewing and managing JSON data.
description:
Json List is a lightweight tool for viewing and managing JSON data.
Open any local JSON file or load one from a URL, then explore it in a clean, user-friendly list format.

Key features:
• Material You dynamic color support
• Split-screen mode for raw JSON + list view
• Search and filter entries for faster navigation
• Edit JSON items directly
